set -euo pipefail; : "${ASTRA_STEP_0_BODY:?CROSS_STEP_EVIDENCE_NOT_EXPOSED}"; mkdir -p canonical/astra_runtime/evidence; python - <<'PY' import json, os, pathlib, re body=os.environ['ASTRA_STEP_0_BODY'] m=re.search(r'Latest Python 3 Release[^0-9]*Python ([0-9.]+)', body, re.I|re.S) if not m: m=re.search(r'Python ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', body) if not m: raise SystemExit('LATEST_VERSION_NOT_EXTRACTED') version=m.group(1) out={'source':'https://www.python.org/downloads/','extracted_latest_version':version} p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.json') p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n') html=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.html') html.write_text(f'

Python release research

Latest observed Python version: {version}

Source: python.org/downloads

') PY
